summary: An architect’s drawing leaves the agenda when the applicant discovers somebody else has rights in the space it uses.
realLife: Penn Central substituted a revised Breuer design after learning that one of the earlier Grand Central schemes conflicted with existing easements. The commission evaluated the replacement.
inGame: needs: a permit case record with drawing, easement, revision. A reporter can explain why the drawing on display differs from the one residents saw earlier.

turns.what: The easement holder releases part of the disputed space after the revised drawing goes out.
turns.pulledBy: A recorded release covers one corner of the earlier design.
turns.writesBack: The architect marks which feature can return on the next sheet.
